title: appname.commandPackage.v1
description: Schema FOR spec/commands/<kind>.yaml — the per-kind machine-readable command package (Artifact-Pack Brief §3 format, the review's Example 1 expanded). One file per §10.3 catalog kind, filename = kind verbatim; _index.yaml carries the catalog roll-up (count == 102, §40.9).

kind.description: §10.3 catalog id, family.verb, lowercase, dot-separated, stable forever (three kinds are single-segment: fill, stroke_path, content_aware_fill)

family.description: the kind's first dot-segment (doc, layer, mask, selection, brush, eraser, clone, heal, dodge_burn, smudge, blur_sharpen, fill, stroke_path, content_aware_fill, edit, adjustment, op, filter, transform, text, vector, channel, guide, grid, smartobject, slice, history, meta, image)

schemaVersion.description: per-kind params-schema id, §40.1 CamelKind derivation (pure function of the kind id)

specRef.description: § anchors: always §10.3 plus the kind's Part 40 section, plus topical §§

class.description: §10.3: R Reversible, M Mergeable, C CheckpointOnly; † travels in the separate dagger flag

dagger.description: true for the † kinds (doc.duplicate, history.snapshot, history.goto) — executes outside the undo stack (§10.3, §10.4)

daggerSemantics.description: REQUIRED prose when dagger=true: the no-history-entry rule and the kind's §40.8/§10.6 journal treatment (marker vs equivalent undo/redo run)

inverse.description: delta | param | snap (§10.3 conventions); mixed forms allowed verbatim from the catalog (e.g. 'delta / param' for transform.*, layer.transform, filter.apply); null for the no-inverse † kinds whose §10.3 column reads '—' (doc.duplicate, history.snapshot)

mergeKey.description: merge-key template per §10.5 ({kind}:{targetId}:{sessionUuid}, property-scoped keys suffix #{propPath}); null when class != M

targetResolution.description: which target/id-valued params must resolve; stage-4 rules (§10.2, §11.1)

selectionBehavior.description: §40.1 vocabulary: ignored | gates coverage | defines region | required | carried | writes selection (+ per-kind nuance)

paramsSchema.description: the kind's registered params schema (JSON Schema draft 2020-12), inline, faithful to the §10.3 row + Part 40 validates lines; x-spec-note fields mark modeled-from-prose shapes

defaults.description: param defaults verbatim from §10.3; null when the row defines none (silence → null + trailing note comment)

dirtyRect.description: the Part 40 dirty: rule (D rect before coalescing; §3.7 merges with 8 px slop, cap 8)

history.description: APPNAME_EV_HISTORY — always for every successful command (§10.3)

dirty.description: APPNAME_EV_DIRTY_RECTS payload rule; null when no composite D

events.description: event order per command is fixed: treeChanged → dirtyRects → history (§9.5)

historyLabel.description: history.<kind> — exists for every kind, no exceptions; registered-but-never-shown for † kinds (§10.3, §40.1)

actionRecording.description: the Part 40 action: line — dialog capture, target rewriting, re-run behavior (§26.1 rules)

scripting.description: one-line §25.4 example per the §40.1 scripting conventions

errors.description: reachable MessageIds: the §40.1 baseline set (never invented) + the Part 40 entry's extras; wildcard families (error.api.*, error.permission.*, error.engine.*) kept as the spec spells them

quartet.description: the §40.1 generated quartet note; † kinds state 'quartet minus prop_cmd_undo'

golden.description: §34.1 corpus documents named by the entry

tests.description: extras beyond the implied quartet (§40.1) + Part 41 workflow refs

case.description: kebab-case slug; each case violates a DIFFERENT rule (brief §3)

envelopeExample.description: a appname.command.v1 instance (§10.2) using documentation UUIDs

x-appname-generated-from: Artifact-Pack Brief §3 (command package format) over ENGINEERING-SPEC.md §10.3 + Part 40
x-appname-rule: a PR changing normative behavior updates the document section, this artifact, its tests, and generated docs IN THE SAME PR (Appendix I). JSON cannot carry comments; the Appendix I header block travels as these x-appname-* fields.
x-spec-note: This schema is DEFINED by the v4.0 artifact pack (the spec prescribes the catalog and per-kind contracts; the package wire format is the brief's Example 1 expanded). class/dagger split follows §10.3's 'R|M|C plus †' convention so §40.9 gate 2 can diff classes and inverse kinds mechanically; inverse stays permissive for the catalog's mixed 'delta / param' cells — normalizing those to one token would falsify §10.3.
x-spec-note-nullability: per the v4.0 artifact convention (Appendix I): a field the spec leaves silent is null plus a note, so every non-core field admits null
